page.overview:
Who is Sirius Black II?

Sirius Black (1877 – 1952) was a pure-blood wizard and a member of the noble House of Black. He was the eldest son of Phineas Nigellus Black and Ursula Flint, and the older brother of Phineas, Arcturus, Belvina and Cygnus II. He married Hesper Gamp and the couple had three children: Arcturus III, Lycoris, and Regulus.

He attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry alongside his younger brother, Phineas, while their father was Headmaster.

Sirius was depicted on the Black family tree tapestry. From the tapestry itself, he was shown to be the second member of the House of Black named "Sirius". He is the paternal great-grandfather of the famous Sirius Black, who was the third member of the family to have this name.

Sirius is the name of the (Alpha Canis Majoris), which, with an apparent magnitude of -1.46, is the brightest star in the night sky.
